She promised to send exercise plan on Friday after being diagnosed with acute sciatic nerve irritation, can’t walk without limping and told her I can’t sleep through the night for 4 days, while visiting her for a consultation.

Almas checked my email address beforehand however , NO plan received. Checked Spam folder, inbox from Friday onwards and nothing has been sent over. Almas also told me she would send my GP a request for stronger painkillers, which would be sent to the pharmacy to be picked up on Monday. I asked her how this would work. She told me in a dismissive tone: leave this to me! I will send an order and the GP will send it to the pharmacy. You can pick this up on Monday.

I called the GP today (Monday afternoon) and lo and behold:  GP confirmed nothing like that was sent over!! The  report from Almas stated ibuprofen and paracetamol don’t work for me and “she (patient) would like to be prescribed stronger painkillers”  which is nothing close to a prescription request!
I now need a new appointment with my GP to get stronger painkillers as Almas did not sent the right request for stronger painkillers! What a waste of time!

Besides this failure I have to add she is very impatient when listening to the complaints and extremely blunt and bossy. She kept repeating she was a senior staff member which is totally unnecessary as I was not questioning her ability.

The appointment was basically a waste of time as the MSK referral she did provide, I could have done via Cora and the GP myself. When calling the the Half Penny Steps I was told they can’t ask Almas to send the exercise plan, because I was referred by the GP and therefore not “known” to the centre which only hosts the physiotherapist but does not provide any sort of admin or info regarding past visits!
AVOID THIS PHYSIO AT ALL COSTS!",null,[0,101]]]],[null,1773748927000000,1773748927000000,"4 days ago",null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/894786127871887043/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjF3YkZveVpHeFlNbVJhWW10c01XVklWVFJqYXpGdlZsWnJlR1JHUlJBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/894786127871887043/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjF3YkZveVpHeFlNbVJhWW10c01XVklWVFJqYXpGdlZsWnJlR1JHUlJBQhAA"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/894786127871887043/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjF3YkZveVpHeFlNbVJhWW10c01XVklWVFJqYXpGdlZsWnJlR1JHUlJBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/894786127871887043/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjF3YkZveVpHeFlNbVJhWW10c01XVklWVFJqYXpGdlZsWnJlR1JHUlJBQhAA"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/894786127871887043/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjF3YkZveVpHeFlNbVJhWW10c01XVklWVFJqYXpGdlZsWnJlR1JHUlJBQhAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/894786127871887043/customers/reviews/reply?p=CkRDaTlEUVVsUlFVTnZaRU5vZEhsalJqbHZUMjF3YkZveVpHeFlNbVJhWW10c01XVklWVFJqYXpGdlZsWnJlR1JHUlJBQhAA"],null,["en"],[["Dear Ana,

Kind regards,
Faraz Ali

I had my cervical screening booked in with Ms Maureen and honestly she ensured I wasn’t nervous and explained the procedure in ample detail. She is an absolute gem and a truly valuable asset to the surgery. She didn’t rush me when I had some questions that needed answering, and instead sat and listened to me! Many thanks Maureen!

Changed from Westbourne green surgery to Half Penny Steps and my only regret is not making the change earlier on! Besides the slight waiting times when you have an appointment at the surgery (can live with that) the doctors/nurses and receptionist try their best to accommodate each patient to the best of their ability.
